nodes.label: aws-secrets-manager ClusterSecretStore
nodes.rationale: Installed and wired to the IRSA role by infra/terraform (addons).

nodes.label: labeler-api ServiceAccount (IRSA)
nodes.rationale: Defined in serviceaccount.yaml; overlays patch its eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn annotation per environment.

nodes.label: WAFv2 Web ACL association
nodes.rationale: Ingress annotated with the WAF ACL ARN from `terraform output api_waf_acl_arn`.

nodes.label: labeler-api Deployment
nodes.rationale: 3 replicas, RollingUpdate with maxUnavailable 0, zone topology spread, hardened securityContext (non-root, read-only rootfs, drop ALL caps); probes on /readyz and /healthz; Prometheus scrape annotations on port 8000 /metrics.

nodes.label: labeler-api HorizontalPodAutoscaler
nodes.rationale: Scales 3-20 replicas on 65% CPU, 300s scale-down stabilization; max 20 matches MAX_API_PODS DB connection budget.

nodes.label: labeler-api Ingress (ALB)
nodes.rationale: Internet-facing AWS ALB with target-type ip, TLS 1.3 policy, healthcheck /readyz; load balancer name pinned so Terraform can find the ALB for alarms (var.api_alb_name).

nodes.label: labeler-api PodDisruptionBudget
nodes.rationale: minAvailable 2 keeps API available during voluntary disruptions.

nodes.label: labeler-api-config ConfigMap
nodes.rationale: Non-secret app settings: Cognito auth mode, RDS verify-full TLS, S3 accelerate, CloudFront, CORS, lease/rejection settings, CloudWatch metrics sink.

nodes.label: labeler-api-secrets ExternalSecret
nodes.rationale: Syncs DATABASE_URL and CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM from AWS Secrets Manager hourly via External Secrets Operator.

nodes.label: Base Kustomization
nodes.rationale: Sets namespace labeler and part-of label; image names are set per environment in overlays since they are separate ECR repositories.

nodes.label: labeler Namespace
nodes.rationale: Enforces Pod Security Standard 'restricted'.

nodes.label: api-egress NetworkPolicy
nodes.rationale: Allows DNS, Postgres 5432 to database subnets 10.40.200.0/22, and HTTPS to public internet (S3, Cognito, STS, CloudWatch) excluding private ranges and metadata service.

nodes.label: api-ingress NetworkPolicy
nodes.rationale: Allows port 8000 from VPC CIDR 10.40.0.0/16 (ALB ENIs, since target-type ip) and from Prometheus in the monitoring namespace.

nodes.label: default-deny NetworkPolicy
nodes.rationale: Default deny ingress and egress; each workload opens only what it needs. Enforced by VPC CNI network policy agent (infra/terraform/eks.tf).

nodes.label: migrate-egress NetworkPolicy
nodes.rationale: Migration Job gets DNS and Postgres only.

nodes.label: reaper-egress NetworkPolicy
nodes.rationale: Reaper needs DNS, Postgres and HTTPS for CloudWatch heartbeat and STS for IRSA.

nodes.label: labeler-reaper CronJob
nodes.rationale: Runs every minute (python -m app.reaper) to return images whose leases expired (closed laptops, dropped connections) to their queue; concurrencyPolicy Forbid, 55s deadline.

nodes.label: Migrate Kustomization
nodes.rationale: Applied by CI before rolling out a new API version: delete old job, apply, wait for completion.

nodes.label: labeler-migrate Job (alembic upgrade head)
nodes.rationale: Runs database schema migrations with alembic before API rollout.

nodes.label: Prod Kustomize overlay
nodes.rationale: Production overlay; REPLACE_ME values filled from terraform output; patches IRSA role, ConfigMap, ExternalSecret keys, Ingress cert/WAF/host.

nodes.label: Staging Kustomize overlay
nodes.rationale: Same manifests as prod but smaller (2 replicas, HPA 2-4, 4 pods x 25 connections) and ENVIRONMENT=staging so metrics dimension, log field and startup guard say staging.

nodes.label: block-metrics ALB fixed-response action
nodes.rationale: Prometheus /metrics is for in-cluster scrapers only, so the ALB answers 404 itself for /metrics.

nodes.label: DB connection budget (20 pods x 17 = 340)
nodes.rationale: MAX_API_PODS=20 times 17 connections per pod = 340 of RDS max_connections (see README 'Database connections'); staging overrides to 4 pods x 25 = 100.
